svg.title: Shah Tunnel / شاه تونل — Network Flow / جریان شبکه
svg.desc: A bilingual diagram of ShahTunnel 1.6.3. Public TCP clients connect to the Hub. The Agent opens authenticated TLS 1.3 lanes to the Hub using one of four TCP-based transports. The Agent forwards mapped traffic to local target services. Adaptive mode spreads lanes across the four transports and reconnects after sustained heartbeat loss.
svg.text: REVERSE TCP RELAY · ADAPTIVE LANE RECOVERY
Option 7: adaptive across all four paths
Agent initiates the outbound control connection; tunnel data is bidirectional
• Each lane remembers its last good path
All 4 current transports use TCP. A total upstream cut cannot be overcome.
